name: Image Finder in Page
description: Find images and visual duplicates in img tags and CSS backgrounds, even while the popup is closed.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' data: blob: http: https:;
